name: Arena-Hard
description: A hard prompt subset benchmark using 500 challenging queries selected from Chatbot Arena, evaluated via GPT-4-Turbo as a judge. Designed specifically to address MT-Bench's poor model separability. Achieves 89.1% agreement with Chatbot Arena Elo ratings, making it one of the highest-correlation automated benchmarks for human preference.
evaluation_method: win rate vs baseline (GPT-4-Turbo as judge)
general_score_metric: win rate (% responses rated better than GPT-4-Turbo baseline)
typical_sota_score: ~80–90% win rate (top frontier models as of 2025–2026)
reputation: Direct successor to MT-Bench for separating frontier models; 89.1% agreement with Chatbot Arena Elo; developed by LMSYS/UC Berkeley; integrated into major leaderboards
notes: Created to fix MT-Bench's saturation problem. Uses 500 user-submitted hard prompts from Chatbot Arena as a more challenging and representative sample. Achieves 89.1% agreement with Arena Elo. Used as part of the LMSYS Arena ecosystem. GPT-4-Turbo serves as the baseline comparison model.
